value.rationale: The exact Tor dimension is a natural quantitative invariant in the homological return problem: it counts bounded polynomial witnesses rather than recording only whether a return occurs. In the published square-time example it proves the obstruction has minimal dimension one at every return; for a two-variable linear constraint it gives a dimension growing as \(n+1\). In general it supplies a precise counting refinement whenever the pullback is a complete intersection.
